newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Ghemini Leasing plans doubled market share.
newsitem.headline: Ghemini Leasing plans doubled market share.

text.p: Pakistan's Ghemini Leasing Co Ltd, which has changed its name, plans to double the market share to six percent from three in the next two years, company chief executive Haroon Ahmed Zuberi said on Tuesday.

The company's new name will be Ghandhara Leasing Company Ltd, he said and added: "It aims to provide low-cost funding, develop a well-diversified lease portfolio, achieve marketing excellence and double its market share in two years from the present three percent to six percent."
"We see good leasing prospects in the next two years," Zuberi told reporters.

The company plans to take $10 million from the Asian Development Bank and another $10 million from the International Finance Corporation to support leasing business in fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), he said.
The company's 10-rupee stock closed unchanged at 14.25 rupees at the Karachi Stock Exchange on Tuesday, a stock broker said. It paid 20 percent cash dividend for 18 months ended in June 1996.
